document: Canada This Month: BC Election Outlook (Innovative Research Group, 2026-09-28)
note: SHARES INCLUDE UNDECIDED. Online panel, n=649 unweighted (weighted to n=500). Regional results are only published on the 'Combined Vote' (vote + lean, all respondents) basis: UNDECIDED = 'Undecided/DK', NONE = 'Would not vote/None'. Regional AUTRES = 'Other', which includes OneBC and CentreBC (small n). National row = combined vote (all respondents) for consistency; decided-voter topline is NDP 41, CON 39, GRN 11, OneBC 4, CentreBC 3, Other 3 (n=411). n = unweighted regional bases from the methodology table (weighted: 297, 93, 110). Region labels verbatim: Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley, Vancouver Island and Sunshine Coast, Interior and North.
